_clinical_governance.framework: ACSM & ISSN Sports Nutrition Position Stand for Female Athletes
_clinical_governance.energy_availability_standard: IOC RED-S Consensus Statement (>30 kcal/kg FFM/day)
_clinical_governance.reviewed_by: Sports Physiologist and Clinical Nutritionist Consultation
_clinical_governance.disclaimer: Informational athletic conditioning and dietary decision-support heuristic for healthy eumenorrheic athletes. Not intended as medical nutrition therapy for clinical endocrine or eating disorders.

menstrual.clinical_rationale: Compensate for acute menstrual hemoglobin and iron depletion (1.5-2.0 mg elemental iron/day) to maintain aerobic capacity (VO2max).

follicular.clinical_rationale: High insulin sensitivity and enhanced glycogen storage under 17beta-estradiol; supports progressive resistance overload and high-intensity output.

ovulatory.clinical_rationale: Peak neuromuscular force output and central drive; replenish acute exertion with sustained carbohydrates and 3.0g leucine-rich protein.

luteal.clinical_rationale: Progesterone-driven thermogenesis elevates resting metabolic rate (+100-300 kcal/day). Extra dietary fiber (32g/day) binds biliary glucuronidated estrogens in the gut to prevent reabsorption.

unknown.clinical_rationale: Baseline balanced nutritional plate adhering to standard ISSN female athlete macros.
